mapper.select: SELECT M.FORM_CD, M.FORM_NM, M.FORM_CAT, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.FORM_CAT) AS FORM_CAT_NM, M.FORM_DESC, M.CURR_VER, M.USE_YN, M.SORT_NO, M.CO_CD, D.FORM_VER, D.FORM_TMPL_HTML, D.FORM_SCHEMA_JSON, D.DFLT_LINE_JSON, D.VER_EXPL, D.APLY_ST_DT FROM TB_AM02M01 M INNER JOIN TB_AM02D01 D ON M.FORM_CD = D.FORM_CD WHERE M.FORM_CD = #{formCd} AND D.FORM_VER = NVL(#{formVer}, M.CURR_VER)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_AM02M01 ( FORM_CD, FORM_NM, FORM_CAT, FORM_DESC, CURR_VER, USE_YN, SORT_NO, CO_CD, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID, UDT_PGM, UDT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{formCd}, #{formNm}, #{formCat}, #{formDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{currVer, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), NVL(#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{sortNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_AM02D01 ( FORM_CD, FORM_VER, FORM_TMPL_HTML, FORM_SCHEMA_JSON, DFLT_LINE_JSON, VER_EXPL, APLY_ST_DT, USE_YN, CO_CD, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID, UDT_PGM, UDT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{formCd}, #{formVer}, #{formTmplHtml, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{formSchemaJson, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{dfltLineJson, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{verExpl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{aplyStDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')), NVL(#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_AM02M01 SET FORM_NM = #{formNm}, FORM_CAT = #{formCat}, FORM_DESC = #{formDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURR_VER = NVL(#{currVer, jdbcType=INTEGER}, CURR_VER), USE_YN = NVL(#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, USE_YN), SORT_NO = NVL(#{sortNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, SORT_NO), UDT_ID = #{userId}, UDT_PGM = #{pgmId}, UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE FORM_CD = #{formCd}
